notes.subject: נצמתי
notes.rationale: 'Cut off/destroyed' (root צמת) vs 'silenced/destroyed'; KJV/ASV 'cut off before darkness', BSB 'silenced by the darkness' — Hebrew verb means extirpate, not silence.

notes.subject: מפני ... ומפני
notes.rationale: 'because of the face of' — readings split: 'before the darkness' (temporal) or 'because of darkness' (causal); idiom has both.

notes.subject: כסה אופל
notes.rationale: Second reading: 'he (El) covered the gloom from my face' — subject is God, per Genev/KJV; I read darkness itself as coverer.

notes.subject: verse
notes.rationale: Job speaks of thick darkness covering him — deliberately opaque closing image of chapter 23.

translation: Bikos tudak i no bin katim mi i go ausait olgeta, na em i karamapim ⟨את⟩ bikpela tudak long arere bilong mi.
